canonical_text_policy: Published slide titles and narration paragraphs are preserved verbatim in text; sentence-boundary chunks and slide pauses prepare the same approved narration for audio; render-only aliases live in tts_text.
pronunciation_policy: Use canonical spelling by default. Add a render-only English respelling only after a bounded same-seed test proves a concrete pronunciation error. IPA is reference metadata only.

chunks.text: The network has many incompatible ports
chunks.tts_text: The network has many incompatible ports

chunks.text: Episode 2 gave us distributed memory. Now stop the historical clock for a moment. The animals in this episode are living examples, not a sequence marching toward humans.
chunks.tts_text: Episode 2 gave us distributed memory. Now stop the historical clock for a moment. The animals in this episode are living examples, not a sequence marching toward humans.

chunks.text: Life communicates through chemistry, color, touch, vibration, electric fields, posture, sound, movement, and combinations of them. Each channel is a different physical port with its own range and limitations.
chunks.tts_text: Life communicates through chemistry, color, touch, vibration, electric fields, posture, sound, movement, and combinations of them. Each channel is a different physical port with its own range and limitations.

chunks.text: A message can be a molecule that lingers, a flash that disappears instantly, a vibration that travels through a web, or a call that crosses a dark forest.
chunks.tts_text: A message can be a molecule that lingers, a flash that disappears instantly, a vibration that travels through a web, or a call that crosses a dark forest.

chunks.text: The question is no longer whether information can cross between bodies. It is what each channel can carry, how fast, how far, and for how long.
chunks.tts_text: The question is no longer whether information can cross between bodies. It is what each channel can carry, how fast, how far, and for how long.

chunks.text: Physics edits every message
chunks.tts_text: Physics edits every message

chunks.text: A chemical mark may persist after the sender leaves, but wind and water smear it. Vision can carry intricate patterns with almost no storage, but only in line of sight. Touch is high-fidelity and nearly zero-range. Vibrations can be excellent if sender and receiver share the right surface.
chunks.tts_text: A chemical mark may persist after the sender leaves, but wind and water smear it. Vision can carry intricate patterns with almost no storage, but only in line of sight. Touch is high-fidelity and nearly zero-range. Vibrations can be excellent if sender and receiver share the right surface.

chunks.text: Sound trades persistence for speed and reach. It vanishes quickly, yet can cross darkness and obstacles. Forests scatter it, wind masks it, and water changes its propagation again.
chunks.tts_text: Sound trades persistence for speed and reach. It vanishes quickly, yet can cross darkness and obstacles. Forests scatter it, wind masks it, and water changes its propagation again.

chunks.text: In computer terms, nature offers no perfect bus. Every channel has latency, range, bandwidth, power cost, and error modes.
chunks.tts_text: In computer terms, nature offers no perfect bus. Every channel has latency, range, bandwidth, power cost, and error modes.

chunks.text: Communication systems therefore branch around environments. A whale ocean, bee hive, and monkey forest are different network problems.
chunks.tts_text: Communication systems therefore branch around environments. A whale ocean, bee hive, and monkey forest are different network problems.

chunks.text: A message can carry a category
chunks.tts_text: A message can carry a category

chunks.text: Classic field experiments with vervet monkeys showed that different alarm calls could trigger responses fitted to different predator classes: look up, look down, or move toward trees.
chunks.tts_text: Classic field experiments with vervet monkeys showed that different alarm calls could trigger responses fitted to different predator classes: look up, look down, or move toward trees.

chunks.text: That made the calls famous as functionally referential signals. Later work added useful caution: call use overlaps across contexts, and receivers combine the sound with recent events, social knowledge, and the surrounding scene.
chunks.tts_text: That made the calls famous as functionally referential signals. Later work added useful caution: call use overlaps across contexts, and receivers combine the sound with recent events, social knowledge, and the surrounding scene.

chunks.text: The important upgrade is not a monkey dictionary. The payload can narrow the world into a meaningful category: danger from above rather than below.
chunks.tts_text: The important upgrade is not a monkey dictionary. The payload can narrow the world into a meaningful category: danger from above rather than below.

chunks.text: A few seconds of sound can save the receiver from having to rediscover the situation from scratch.
chunks.tts_text: A few seconds of sound can save the receiver from having to rediscover the situation from scratch.

chunks.text: A message can point somewhere else
chunks.tts_text: A message can point somewhere else

chunks.text: Inside a dark honeybee hive, a returning forager can dance about a place that is not there.
chunks.tts_text: Inside a dark honeybee hive, a returning forager can dance about a place that is not there.

chunks.text: The angle of the waggle run carries directional information relative to the sun, while duration varies with distance. Radar-tracking experiments showed recruited bees initially flying the indicated vector before using local cues to finish the search.
chunks.tts_text: The angle of the waggle run carries directional information relative to the sun, while duration varies with distance. Radar-tracking experiments showed recruited bees initially flying the indicated vector before using local cues to finish the search.

chunks.text: This is an addressing upgrade. The sender is not merely saying act now. The message helps the receiver navigate toward a remote target outside the current scene.
chunks.tts_text: This is an addressing upgrade. The sender is not merely saying act now. The message helps the receiver navigate toward a remote target outside the current scene.

chunks.text: The packet is compact and specialized, but it reaches beyond the sender's body and the receiver's immediate view.
chunks.tts_text: The packet is compact and specialized, but it reaches beyond the sender's body and the receiver's immediate view.

chunks.text: A message can address one individual
chunks.tts_text: A message can address one individual

chunks.text: Bottlenose dolphins develop learned, individually distinctive signature whistles. Playback studies show that receivers recognize identity from the whistle's frequency pattern, not only from voice quality.
chunks.tts_text: Bottlenose dolphins develop learned, individually distinctive signature whistles. Playback studies show that receivers recognize identity from the whistle's frequency pattern, not only from voice quality.

chunks.text: Dolphins also copy familiar companions' signature whistles, and field experiments support the idea that those copies can be used to address a particular individual.
chunks.tts_text: Dolphins also copy familiar companions' signature whistles, and field experiments support the idea that those copies can be used to address a particular individual.

chunks.text: Calling them names can overstate the evidence, but the information-system point is already strong: a sound pattern can select one social partner from many.
chunks.tts_text: Calling them names can overstate the evidence, but the information-system point is already strong: a sound pattern can select one social partner from many.

chunks.text: Category, location, identity. The channel is carrying increasingly specific addresses.
chunks.tts_text: Category, location, identity. The channel is carrying increasingly specific addresses.

chunks.text: A small repertoire can be recombined
chunks.tts_text: A small repertoire can be recombined

chunks.text: Male Campbell's monkeys produce a small repertoire of alarm and social calls. Researchers found regular modifications and call sequences associated with different contexts.
chunks.tts_text: Male Campbell's monkeys produce a small repertoire of alarm and social calls. Researchers found regular modifications and call sequences associated with different contexts.

chunks.text: That matters because the system does not require a completely new signal for every circumstance. A limited inventory can be reused in larger patterns.
chunks.tts_text: That matters because the system does not require a completely new signal for every circumstance. A limited inventory can be reused in larger patterns.

chunks.text: Human ears immediately want to install a grammar package. Resist. Researchers disagree about how terms such as syntax and compositionality should be applied across species, and the monkey repertoire remains small and context-bound.
chunks.tts_text: Human ears immediately want to install a grammar package. Resist. Researchers disagree about how terms such as syntax and compositionality should be applied across species, and the monkey repertoire remains small and context-bound.

chunks.text: Still, recombination changes the arithmetic. Reuse is a kind of compression: more possible messages from fewer basic units.
chunks.tts_text: Still, recombination changes the arithmetic. Reuse is a kind of compression: more possible messages from fewer basic units.

chunks.text: Then the clock becomes foggy again
chunks.tts_text: Then the clock becomes foggy again

chunks.text: We have now seen messages carry danger, direction, identity, and limited combinations. None of these living species is an earlier chapter of humanity. They show ingredients scattered across animal evolution.
chunks.tts_text: We have now seen messages carry danger, direction, identity, and limited combinations. None of these living species is an earlier chapter of humanity. They show ingredients scattered across animal evolution.

chunks.text: Human language has a radically more open-ended expressive range, but language itself left no fossil. Anatomy, archaeology, genetics, living languages, and comparisons with other animals constrain the story without supplying a date for the first sentence.
chunks.tts_text: Human language has a radically more open-ended expressive range, but language itself left no fossil. Anatomy, archaeology, genetics, living languages, and comparisons with other animals constrain the story without supplying a date for the first sentence.

chunks.text: So the historical clock becomes uncertain just as message capacity is about to jump. We are moving from deep animal history into millions of years of human-lineage evolution, but not toward a defensible birthday.
